planets.name: K2-77 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-77 with a 8.2-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-77 b was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-77. Its orbit and size follow Thygesen et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
